verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a post-formation legal dashboard for further paperwork, such as adopting a stock plan, issuing stock and options, and issuing safes and notes. Its document sets bundle documents and signatures that are signed on Clerky, with real-time collaboration and attorney review. A community user also cites a post-incorporation Fundraising/Maintenance package. However, no evidence explicitly names board consents or resolutions, or describes routing them to directors for approval. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of board consent/resolution templates, a director approval and e-signature workflow for board actions, and independent corroboration of board-consent use.
